title: Splitting torsion classes in higher homological algebra
summary: Let $d \geqslant 1$ be an integer, $\mathscr{M}$ a suitable $d$-abelian category. There is a notion of higher torsion classes in $\mathscr{M}$, also known as $d$-torsion classes. We generalise a classic theorem of Hoshino by providing criteria for a $d$-torsion class $\mathscr{U}$ to be splitting, notably that $\mathscr{U}$ is stable under $τ_d^-$, the inverse $d$-Auslander--Reiten translation.
